purpose: Frozen language regression for teacher baseline and student evaluation using the same inputs. This is not an Android navigation, action, app-access or completion benchmark.
split_policy: Evaluation only. Never use these rows, inputs, outputs or paraphrases to train/distill, select checkpoints, tune prompts or select a winning model. Use a separate synthetic training set and disjoint validation set. Report contamination and freeze a replacement suite if these examples inform development.
privacy: Public repository synthetic fixtures plus original fictional names, item titles and excerpts. No captures, device chats, private messages, account data, credentials or live app contents.

sources.use: All 24 original rows copied with unchanged input/expected patch.
11 valid synthetic language cases; invalid/runtime protocol cases remain in their original suite.
Public Maps/calendar query themes only; no device oracles or execution claims.
Public app navigation/search family themes only; account observations are not copied.

families.task_update: Saved calendar/search replies; exact unique spans and typed normalization, native paths identified separately.
families.writing: Short drafting, rewrite, email, title, query and summary with lexical checks and mandatory semantic review.
families.intent: Item vs collection, exact literals, cross-turn cited research references, absent evidence, app/item separation and ordinal references.
families.goal: Research-only high-level interpretation and data dependencies for calendar, hotel/Gemini, Maps, CRED bills, messages, handoff, media, navigation and app search.

scoring.structured: Strict full expected object equality; expected_any enumerates independently valid whole-object alternatives. task_update update order is immaterial. Schema/span/grounding checks are separate from semantic target agreement.
scoring.writing: Mechanical literals/regex/word limits are necessary checks, not a semantic pass; every accepted draft remains pending human review.
scoring.native: Native fast paths, unsupported guards and unresolved intent rejection are expected annotations, not measured by unconstrained GPU inference.
scoring.goals: All values remain literal request/context substrings. Ordered capabilities describe dependencies only. date/end mean calendar date/end or hotel check-in/checkout according to capability. The partial field schema omits occupancy, price/account controls, UI gestures and execution receipts; do not treat it as booking readiness.

excludes.reason: Protocol outcomes must be checked in the existing runtime suite rather than mistaken for teacher language quality.

Permissions, authentication, current screen state, actual message delivery, playback, provider calendar insertion, Gemini completion/copy, hotel field entry and app/bill access require independent device evidence.
Battery sensor readouts, alarms, dark-mode toggles, payments, purchases and bookings lack labels in this deliberately bounded language schema; they are not claimed as covered.
This pilot is English text; speech recognition quality, locale ambiguity, multilingual generation and voice wake behavior need separate data.
